proof_payload.boundary: ERC-8274 recompute/cross-reference-console — claim_id independently re-derived from the live /ledger #240 source with reference/claim_id.py and checked against the registered ClaimPreimage; decision_ref taken as-is from the source rather than re-derived from its own sub-preimage. Not run inside the gateway container, so dependency_lock, runtime_image and execution_witness are honestly null rather than carried over from a run that had them. First Cell on this claim: this opens the edge, it does not close one. Envelope validity is outside this boundary and is established by EIP-712 signer recovery against the registered address.

Note claim_preimage.artifact_type is 'review_verdict' (what the CLAIM is) while the source's verdict.artifact_type describes what was REVIEWED; two axes, and reconciling them by copying would change claim_id (CLAIM.md).
